A1Y06:1153 ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT ZONING LOT AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement"), made as of this 21st day of September, 2006 (the “Effective Date"), by and between Lucia C. Tuan, an individual,having an address at 1433 Second Avenue, New York, New York ("Seller"), and Buttermilk Diamonds LLC, DG Second Avenue LLC, Upper Second Avenue LLC, Grace East 74th LLC,MG Yorkville LLC,East 74th Street Yorkville LLC and LG 1431 Second Avenue LLC, each a New York limited liability company, each having an address c/o Herrick, Feinstein LLP, 2 Park Avenue, New York, New York 10016 ("Developer"). RECIIALS: A.Seller is the fee owner of the land described on Schedule A annexed hereto, which land is designated as Lot 26 in Block 1429 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, New York County (the “Tax Map") and known by the street address of 1433 Second Avenue, New York, New York (such land, “Seller's Land"), together with the improvements Improvements are collectively referred to herein as “Seller's Property"). As of the date hereof, Seller's Improvements consist of a 4-story building and sub-grade basement with no mezzanine floors or levels (such building, as the same exists as of the date hereof, “Seller's Existing Building"). B.Developer is the owner of all of the lands described on Schedule B annexed hereto,which lands are designated as Lot 25(formerly Lots 21,22,23,24,25,121 and 122) in Block 1429 on the Tax Map and known by the street address of 1431 Second Avenue, NewYorkNewYork(formerly1421-1431SecondAvenueand253East74thStreet,NewYork, New York) (such lands are collectively, “Developer's Land"), together with the improvements now or hereafter located on Developer's Land ("Developer's Improvements") C. Developer is the owner of certain development rights (the “Adjacent Development Rights") appurtenant to the parcel of lands known as 1435 Second Avenue, 1439 Second Avenue and 244 East 75th Street, New York, New York, and being Lots 27,28 and 127, respectively, in Block 1429 on the Tax Map (collectively, the “Other Lands"). D.Developer may (but in no event shall be obligated to) renovate Developer's Improvements or construct a new building or buildings and improvements upon all or a portion of Developer's Land or other adjacent land (said new or renovated building or buildings and improvements, together with any further replacements thereof or additions thereto whether made by Developer or Developer's successors or assigns, whether upon Developer's Land or other adjacent land, being herein referred to as “Developer's Proposed Building” and acquired by Developer in connection with Developer's Proposed Building, and Developer's Proposed Building being herein collectively referred to as “Developer's Property").
